summary: Fresenius Medical Care AG filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated October 7, 2026, announcing that Shervin J. Korangy, 51, will become CEO and Chair of the Management Board effective October 12, 2026, succeeding Helen Giza, who served four years as CEO after three as CFO. The Supervisory Board unanimously appointed him; Chairman Michael Sen cited a strategic inflection point after the FME25+ program cut costs by roughly EUR 1.2 billion. Korangy, a Supervisory Board member since 2023 and former BVI Medical CEO, will pursue profitable growth. No deal terms apply; watch execution risk and strategy continuity.
